reply_text:
I’d hold the merge. Found three correctness issues:

• **Wrong extension for multi-dot filenames** — `src/extension.js:2` takes the second segment, not the last. `scan.preview.pdf` gets `application/octet-stream`; `photo.jpg.exe` incorrectly gets `image/jpeg`. Use the final suffix, returning `''` when there’s no dot.

• **Uppercase extensions aren’t normalized** — `src/extension.js:2` leaves casing unchanged, contrary to the README. `photo.JPG` and `Archive.TAR.GZ` both fall back to `application/octet-stream`. Lowercase the extracted extension.

• **Unknown extensions can return inherited objects/functions** — `src/content-type.js:11` looks up keys on a normal object without checking ownership. `file.constructor` returns a function and `file.__proto__` returns an object instead of the documented fallback string. Use an own-property check, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`.

**Validation:** All 3 existing tests pass; I reproduced the cases above with read-only checks. Add coverage for these cases and the documented no-dot/trailing-dot behavior before merging.

No files changed.
